ConnectionStrings._comment: Real values belong in appsettings.Production.json (gitignored) or User Secrets for local dev — these placeholders exist so the shape is documented and so a dev box without a real SQL Server gets a clear connection-refused error instead of a config-binding error. Mirrors config.js's single-login/three-database shape (Nexus/NexusOperations/NexusArchive), just split into three named connection strings instead of one config block with per-database overrides. MultipleActiveResultSets=True is required — confirmed for real against a live SQL Server that several Helpers (AuthService.LoginAsync, UserAdminHelper.ListUsersAsync, IsoparDeclarationHelper.ComputePeriodFiguresAsync, and likely others not yet hit) run multiple concurrent Dapper queries against one already-open connection via Task.WhenAll, which throws 'The connection does not support MultipleActiveResultSets' without this — every prior test used a mocked connection, so this never surfaced until real DB traffic did.

Auth._comment: Mirrors config.js's IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS/SHORT_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS defaults exactly (30 min / 5 min) — see Services/Auth/IdleTimeoutPolicy.cs.

SapCredentials._comment: MUST be the identical 64-hex-char value as the Node app's SAP_CRED_ENCRYPTION_KEY env var — see Services/Auth/SapCredentialCipher.cs. Real value belongs in appsettings.Production.json (gitignored).

SapServer._comment: Real values belong in appsettings.Production.json (gitignored). JwtSecret MUST match the SapServer app's own Auth:JwtSecret (appsettings.Production.json there) — it's the shared HMAC-SHA256 secret both apps sign/validate against, same as sql2005-bridge's relationship to SapServer. Mirrors config.js's sapConfig.url / sapServerSecret and sap.js's makeSapToken (issuer 'normanton-nexus', audience 'sap-server', 60s expiry) — see Services/SapServerClient.cs.

LabelPrinters._comment: Mirrors config.json's top-level `printers` array (config.js's printersConfig) — see Services/LabelPrinterOptions.cs / Helpers/Production/LabelPrintHelper.cs. Real values belong in appsettings.Production.json.

Logistics._comment: Mirrors config.json's logistics block (shipmentmain.js's getLogisticsSettings) — see Services/LogisticsOptions.cs. Origin-address fields already have safe Node-matching defaults, so aren't repeated here. ExportRoot/ImportRoot/PoRoot MUST be real absolute Windows/UNC paths in production (appsettings.Production.json) — omitted here so LogisticsOptions' own AppContext.BaseDirectory-derived defaults (the real analog of Node's process.cwd() fallback) apply instead of a relative string that would always fail the Assert*Root validation. Real values (ExportRoot/ImportRoot/PoRoot/OriginId/MailFrom/MailCc/MailBcc/SmtpPort/SmtpSecure/SmtpHelloName) belong in appsettings.Production.json — mirrors .env's LOGISTICS_EXPORT_ROOT/IMPORT_ROOT/PO_ROOT/ORIGIN_ID/EMAIL_FROM/EMAIL_CC/EMAIL_BCC/SMTP_PORT/SMTP_SECURE/SMTP_HELLO_NAME. LOGISTICS_SMTP_HOST/USER/PASS have no real value in .env either (still a placeholder relay host there) — left at LogisticsOptions' own blank default until a real SMTP relay exists.

ClearPort._comment: Real values belong in appsettings.Production.json (gitignored) or User Secrets for local dev — mirrors .env's CLEARPORT_API_URL/CLEARPORT_API_TOKEN/CLEARPORT_SANDBOX and config.json's logistics.clearport.ddpConsignee. UNVERIFIED against a live ClearPort sandbox — see ClearPortClient's own header comment. ApiUrl's default (https://api.clear-port.com) already matches Node's own fallback, so it only needs overriding here if ClearPort ever changes it; ApiToken has no safe default and must be set for either ClearPort integration to work (ShipmentCustomsHelper's per-shipment export declaration, Sub-phase 8a.5c; ClearPortExportProxyController's raw /v1/cds/exports proxy, Sub-phase 8c.4 — the latter sends it as a Bearer token, the former as an X-API-Key header, a real inconsistency already present in Node itself, not something unified here). Sandbox/DdpConsignee* are unset here (Sandbox defaults false, DdpConsignee* default null) — real environment has Sandbox=true and a populated DdpConsignee (appsettings.Production.json). See Services/ClearPortOptions.cs.

KuehneNagel._comment: Real values belong in appsettings.Production.json (gitignored) or User Secrets for local dev — mirrors .env's KN_CUSTOMER_ID/KN_CUSTOMER_KEY/KN_SECRET_64 (Logistics Sub-phase 8c.3 freight booking). ApiUrl is NOT set here — KuehneNagelOptions.ApiUrl's own C# default now already carries the real, confirmed production KN booking endpoint (not a secret; a prior version of this file had the wrong, stale KN_API_URL value copied from .env.example, since fixed against the real .env directly). KN_DOCUMENTS_API_URL is NOT ported — confirmed dead/unused in Node's own routes/freightbooking.js (its real document-upload call is KN_API_URL + '/documents', not a separate documents-API base URL). KN's OAuth token endpoint (https://portal.api.kuehne-nagel.com/oauth2/token) is hardcoded in KuehneNagelClient, not configurable, so there's no setting for it here. Secret is already the full base64 Basic-auth value Node sends as-is (KN_SECRET_64), never re-encoded by this app. UNVERIFIED against a live KN sandbox. See Services/KuehneNagelOptions.cs.

Resend._comment: Real value belongs in appsettings.Production.json (gitignored) — mirrors .env's RESEND_API_KEY (routes/auth.js's forgot-password email dispatch, resend.emails.send). FromAddress already matches Node's own hardcoded 'Normanton Nexus <onboarding@resend.dev>' sender, so it isn't repeated in Production unless that ever changes. UNVERIFIED against a live Resend account. See Services/ResendClient.cs.
